Physics | BYU Graduate Program Overview
The Department of Physics and Astronomy is part of BYU's graduate program. You can find general information about BYU's graduate program in the official graduate catalog.
Both MS and PhD programs are available at BYU. More information about the specific degrees and programs offered by the Physics & Astronomy department and how to apply can be found on their website.
